faq.q: Is Stave Falls part of Mission?
faq.a: Yes — Stave Falls is a rural community inside the City of Mission: the City's Rural Mission Strategy names Stave Falls among the rural communities it covers and ties that work to the City's Official Community Plan, so City planning, zoning and tax rules apply here, unlike in unincorporated Dewdney-Deroche to the east.

faq.q: What is the Powerhouse at Stave Falls?
faq.a: BC Hydro's original Stave Falls powerhouse, built in 1912 and once B.C.'s biggest hydroelectric power source; it operated until a new powerhouse replaced it in 2000 and now serves as a BC Hydro Visitor Centre and museum, designated a National Historic Site.
